# YouTube
> Video sharing and streaming platform for watching, uploading, and managing videos, channels, live streams, and creator content.

YouTube provides consumer video experiences, creator publishing tools through YouTube Studio, developer APIs via Google, and policy, support, and product resources for viewers, creators, advertisers, and partners.

## Watch & Discover
- [Home](https://www.youtube.com/): Main YouTube homepage for discovering recommended videos, channels, and trending content.
- [Shorts](https://www.youtube.com/shorts): Short-form vertical video feed for browsing and creating YouTube Shorts.
- [Music](https://music.youtube.com/): Dedicated music streaming experience for songs, albums, playlists, and artists.
- [Kids](https://www.youtubekids.com/): Child-focused YouTube experience with curated videos and parental controls.
- [Live](https://www.youtube.com/live): Hub for discovering live streams, premieres, and live events on YouTube.
- [Gaming](https://gaming.youtube.com/): Gaming-focused destination for streams, videos, and creator content.

## Creator Tools
- [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com/): Creator dashboard for uploading videos, managing channels, and reviewing analytics.
- [Channel Dashboard](https://studio.youtube.com/): Central workspace for recent performance, comments, and publishing actions.
- [Content Manager Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257498): Help resources for managing videos, Shorts, and live content.
- [Analytics Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9314351): Documentation for understanding channel, audience, and revenue analytics.
- [Live Streaming Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257892): Guidance for setting up, managing, and troubleshooting YouTube live streams.
- [YouTube Create](https://www.youtube.com/create): Official creator-focused destination for production and publishing resources.

## Creator Education
- [YouTube Creators](https://www.youtube.com/creators/): Official creator resource hub with best practices, news, and growth guidance.
- [Creator Academy](https://creatoracademy.youtube.com/): Structured lessons and courses for building channels and improving content strategy.
- [How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/): Explanations of policies, systems, product features, and platform operations.
- [YouTube Official Blog](https://blog.youtube/): Product updates, creator news, and company announcements from YouTube.
- [Culture & Trends](https://www.youtube.com/trends/): Insights into trending topics, creator culture, and audience behavior on YouTube.

## Developer Resources
- [YouTube API Services](https://developers.google.com/youtube): Main developer portal for YouTube APIs, tools, and implementation guides.
- [Data API v3](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3): Reference and guides for accessing YouTube videos, channels, playlists, and search data.
- [Live Streaming API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live): API documentation for managing broadcasts, streams, and live events.
- [Player Parameters](https://developers.google.com/youtube/player_parameters): Embedded player configuration options and playback parameter reference.
- [IFrame Player API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/iframe_api_reference): JavaScript API for embedding and controlling YouTube players.
- [Android Player API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/android/player): Android integration resources for embedding YouTube video playback.
- [YouTube APIs Terms of Service](https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/api-services-terms-of-service): Terms governing access to and use of YouTube API services.

## Help & Support
- [YouTube Help Center](https://support.google.com/youtube/): Main support portal for viewers, creators, and account management issues.
- [Get Started on YouTube](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257498): Introductory help for uploading, managing, and organizing YouTube content.
- [Account & Settings Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257109): Support for sign-in, channel settings, privacy, and account controls.
- [Watch Videos Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9257518): Guidance for playback, subscriptions, watch history, and viewing features.
- [YouTube Premium Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9153641): Support for Premium memberships, offline viewing, and background playback.
- [YouTube Music Help](https://support.google.com/youtubemusic/): Support resources for YouTube Music apps, playback, and subscriptions.
- [YouTube TV Help](https://support.google.com/youtubetv/): Help center for YouTube TV plans, devices, recordings, and billing.

## Policies & Safety
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/policies/community-guidelines/): Rules governing acceptable content and behavior on the platform.
- [Copyright Center](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/policies/copyright/): Information about copyright rules, claims, takedowns, and dispute processes.
- [Policy Center](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9282679): Central support hub for YouTube policies, enforcement, and restrictions.
- [Safety Center](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/our-commitments/safeguarding-our-community/): Overview of YouTube’s safety commitments and community protection efforts.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms): Legal terms governing use of YouTube services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Google privacy policy applicable to YouTube services and accounts.

## Monetization & Business
- [YouTube Partner Program](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/9153642): Eligibility, setup, and monetization guidance for creator revenue programs.
- [Monetization Policies](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/1311392): Rules and requirements for earning revenue from YouTube content.
- [Ads on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/ads/): Advertising solutions and campaign information for reaching audiences on YouTube.
- [BrandConnect](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/10343433): Resources for branded content and creator partnership opportunities.
- [Shopping on YouTube](https://support.google.com/youtube/topic/12257663): Help for product tagging, storefronts, and shopping features.
- [YouTube Premium](https://www.youtube.com/premium): Subscription offering for ad-free viewing and additional playback features.

## Products & Services
- [YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/): Live TV streaming service with channels, DVR, and household viewing features.
- [YouTube Music Premium](https://music.youtube.com/music_premium): Subscription music experience with offline and background listening.
- [YouTube Premium](https://www.youtube.com/premium): Paid membership for ad-free videos, downloads, and background play.
- [YouTube Podcasts](https://www.youtube.com/podcasts): Podcast discovery and listening destination on YouTube.
- [YouTube for Artists](https://artists.youtube.com/): Resources for artists managing music presence and audience growth on YouTube.

## Company & Press
- [About YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/about/): Company overview, product mission, and high-level information about YouTube.
- [Press](https://www.youtube.com/about/press/): Media resources, announcements, and press contacts for YouTube.
- [Careers at YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/jobs/): Employment information and links to YouTube-related career opportunities.
- [YouTube Official Blog](https://blog.youtube/): Official source for product launches, features, and company updates.
- [Google Safety Center](https://safety.google/): Broader Google safety, privacy, and security information relevant to YouTube.
